title: Beverages Limited and King Beverages are recognised in the period in which
columns:
Beverage sales relate to sales by Almasi
Beverages Limited and King Beverages
Limited who deal in Soft drinks,
Coca Cola and Alcoholic beverages
respectively.

Revenues from the various sources
are recognised in the period in which
the company has delivered products
to the customer, the customer has full
discretion over the channel and price to
sell the products, and there is no unfulfilled
obligation that could affect the customers’
acceptance of the products. Delivery does
not occur until the products have been
accepted by the customer.
